The '''Celegia system''' was a part of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Noori sector/Legends|Noori sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Celegia]], which had a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[cyanogen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celegian/Legends|Celegians]]. By [[17,000 BBY]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Exploitation Region]]. The Celegia system had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], and it fell under the [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] around [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].

==Description==
The Celegia system was situated in the [[Noori sector/Legends|Noori sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By approximately [[17,000 BBY]], [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] linked the [[Star system/Legends|system]] to the [[Belasco system/Legends|Belasco system]] as well as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Virujansi system/Legends|Virujansi system]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Those [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes persisted until the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[3996 BBY]] but had ceased to exist by the beginning of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3976 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Celegia system<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Celegia|same name]]. It had raging [[Water/Legends|seas]] and an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with large amounts of the generally [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] [[cyanogen]].<ref name="UAA" />

==History==
[[File:CelegiaAlsakanConflicts-EGTW.jpg|thumb|left|235px|Around 17,000 BBY, the Celegia system was a part of the Exploitation Region.]]
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding the Celegia system was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> and by 17,000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the system was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Around the latter point in [[Time/Legends|time]], which saw the [[First Alsakan Conflict|beginning]] of a [[Alsakan Conflicts/Legends|series]] of [[Politics/Legends|conflicts]] between the planet [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]]; the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]; and their respective allies, the Celegia system was located in the [[Exploitation Region]]&mdash;a territory that was actively controlled by Coruscant-affiliated [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] conglomerates known as the [[Grand Companies]]. In addition, the hyperspace route linking the Celegia and Belasco systems was under Coruscant's control. The hyperlane connecting the Celegia system to the Virujansi system, however, was among the routes that were either neutral or contested during the conflicts.<ref name="EGTW" />

During the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the Republic's [[Fourth Outer Rim Army|Fourth Sector Army]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the Celegia system's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the Clone Wars, the Celegia system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref> By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the [[Star/Legends|star]] system had become a part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> As part of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], at some point by [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]], the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] had gained [[Yuuzhan Vong empire|control]] over the Celegia system.<ref name="TEA" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Celegian/Legends}}
Celegia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Celegian/Legends|Celegian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UAA" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the population of the Celegia system numbered between ten and one hundred million.<ref name="TEA" /> The Celegians eventually established a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tramanos]], which,<ref name="Gazetter">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-knight-errant-gazetter|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The Knight Errant Gazetteer|int=The Knight Errant Gazetteer}}</ref> similar to Celegia,<ref name="UAA" /> also had cyanogen in its atmosphere.<ref name="Gazetter" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Celegia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square O-10.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on StarWars.com<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the system's first appearance.<ref name="AoI" />
